payload.title: Spike: a publication repo consumes Papyrus from packages and deploys CMS + backend + staging (Pilobol.us)
payload.description: Phase 1 spike per docs/standard-site.md (PR #98). Prove, on a scratch copy of the Pilobol.us setup, that a publication repo can depend on Papyrus through packages (papyrus-newsroom on PyPI; @anthusai/papyrus and @anthusai/papyrus-infra on npm) and build/deploy its newsroom CMS app + Amplify Gen 2 backend + a staging site on Amplify. NOT allowed: publishing to the public registries (use local packs / wheels), touching production apps (pilobol.us d1od6t7lzbwanr, newsroom.pilobol.us d11eu9hbs2mipk, p.apyr.us dbsyytcm9drqa, anth.us d2hbn1ig6nqyhy, TI d3on1y5vlrxmam). Acceptance checklist at the end of docs/standard-site.md.
